messages:
Alex: deploy-bot reports p95 spike and increased tail errors on /generate for convo-v3 in the middle of the canary. Auto-rollback disabled due to maintenance-window. We need a quick decision: full revert to convo-v2, pin, or conservative traffic-slice rollback?

deploy-bot: :warning: ALERT: route=conversational.generate model=convo-v3 p95=920ms error-rate=0.9% trigger=latency+5xx. Auto-rollback suppressed (maintenance-window). Suggested actions: manual revert OR reduce canary slice to 2% and monitor for 15m. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/rollback-guidance

Casey: logs show the errors concentrated on a single region and affected shard 7 only. I'd prefer slice-first to avoid churn.

Alex: agree slice-first. DevOps, can you execute and own the watch? If it stays bad after 15m we revert.

DevOps: taking ownership. I'll run: `rclient traffic adjust --route conversational.generate --model convo-v3 --slice 0.02` and start a 15m monitor. If p95 > 600ms or 5xx > 0.5% we run `rclient deploy revert --route conversational.generate --model convo-v2`.

Priya: I'll prepare a brief internal note for #deploy-notifications and draft a short customer blurb in #release-notes-drafts in case we need to revert.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automation disabled. Manual traffic change and revert commands are available in runbook. Events will post to #deploy-notifications when executed.

DevOps: applied slice -> new canary slice = 2% (by devops). Starting 15m watch.

Casey: 5m in: p95 dropped to 480ms, 5xx to 0.18%. Region-specific logs show a GC spike on one instance. Looks better.

Alex: good. keep the slice low, let GC settle and then ramp slowly. If it's stable at 15m, move to 10% then continue incremental ramp.

DevOps: 15m check -> p95 ~470ms, 5xx 0.12%. No revert. Leaving slice at 2% and will ramp to 10% in 10 minutes if stable.

Priya: posted release note draft: "Observed elevated latency during canary for convo-v3; engineering throttled canary traffic and is monitoring. No customer-impacting rollback required at this time." Posted to #release-notes-drafts.

Support: Opening ticket TKT-176999 to track customer comms if we revert. Assigned to Support and Alex.

Alex: summary: manual intervention (traffic-slice down) executed; automation still suppressed. Action items: DevOps monitor + ramp plan, Priya release note, Support ticket owner. Reopen thread if thresholds breached.

deploy-bot: SUMMARY: manual traffic-slice executed; auto-rollback suppressed by maintenance-window.
